story: Mahabali, grandson of Prahlada, was an asura king so just and generous that he won all three worlds. Vishnu came to him as Vamana, a young dwarf brahmin, and asked for just three steps of land. Vamana grew to fill the universe in two steps, and Mahabali offered his own head for the third.
belief: Kerala celebrates Onam every year because people believe Mahabali comes back once a year to visit his people. He is an immortal and a symbol of a golden age when everyone was equal.
turns: He ignored his guru Shukracharya's warning about who Vamana really was. Some say it was his pride in his own generosity that Vishnu came to humble.
facts: He was sent to rule Sutala, one of the lower worlds, rather than destroyed.
In Malayalam he is called Maveli.
